decks.notes: This deck focuses on assembling a variety of creatures to tutor for using Chord of Calling, creating a toolbox of options for different situations. The deck aims to use creatures like Yawgmoth, Thran Physician and Grist, the Hunger Tide to generate value and control the board. Additionally, cards like Zulaport Cutthroat and Hapatra, Vizier of Poisons provide additional win conditions. The deck also includes key lands like Pendelhaven and Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth to support its strategy. By utilizing a combination of creatures and spells, this deck aims to out-value and outmaneuver the opponent in a Modern 1 vs 1 format.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on aggressively disrupting the opponent's hand and graveyard while deploying efficient threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Grief to pressure the opponent's life total. The deck also utilizes removal spells like Terminate and Lightning Bolt to control the board and maintain tempo. With its mix of hand disruption, powerful creatures, and removal, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly and close out the game before they have a chance to recover.

The main concept of this deck is to focus on aggressive tactics, dealing direct damage to the opponent as quickly as possible. With a combination of burn spells like Lava Spike, Lightning Bolt, Rift Bolt, and others, along with powerful creatures like Goblin Guide and Monastery Swiftspear, this deck aims to quickly reduce the opponent's life total to zero. The inclusion of cards like Boros Charm and Skullcrack adds versatility and disruption to keep the pressure on the opponent. Land cards like Sunbaked Canyon and Roiling Vortex provide additional damage and card advantage to further enhance this aggressive strategy.

This deck focuses on assembling the UrzaTron lands (Urza's Mine, Urza's Power Plant, Urza's Tower) to generate massive amounts of mana quickly. It uses card selection and ramping tools like Ancient Stirrings, Expedition Map, and Sylvan Scrying to find the pieces needed. The deck also utilizes control elements like Ensnaring Bridge and Karn Liberated to protect itself while setting up the Tron lands. Karn, the Great Creator and Ugin, the Spirit Dragon provide additional threats and disruption. Jegantha, the Wellspring serves as a Companion that can provide an additional way to generate mana.

This Mono Black Control deck focuses on disruption, removal, and resource denial to dominate the game. Using cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to disrupt opponents' plans, along with Karn, the Great Creator's toolbox abilities and Cling to Dust for card advantage, the deck aims to control the board and outvalue opponents. The deck also aims to ramp up its mana with cards like Cabal Coffers and Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth to cast powerful finishers like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and March of Wretched Sorrow to secure the win.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on aggressive plays using cards like Bloodstained Mire, Thoughtseize, and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer to disrupt the opponent's strategy and deal damage quickly. The deck utilizes a combination of removal spells like Terminate and Lightning Bolt to control the board while employing creatures like Dauthi Voidwalker, Grief, and Fury to apply pressure. The key strategy revolves around a fast-paced, proactive approach to overwhelm the opponent before they can establish their own game plan. The deck's aggressive nature is further emphasized by cards like Undying Evil and Orcish Bowmasters to maintain board presence and push for victory.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of counterspells, removal, and powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six. It utilizes a diverse mana base to cast spells of multiple colors and has access to powerful cards like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines. The deck also includes ramp spells like Bring to Light and Up the Beanstalk to help accelerate its game plan. The overall strategy is to disrupt the opponent's game plan while setting up for powerful late-game plays.

The deck focuses on controlling the game early on with ramp spells like Search for Tomorrow and Misty Rainforest, leading up to a powerful win condition with Scapeshift and Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle. Time Warp and Bring to Light provide additional utility and flexibility in the deck's game plan. Teferi, Time Raveler helps to protect the combo pieces and disrupt opponents, while Dryad of the Ilysian Grove and Omnath, Locus of Creation provide additional ramp and card advantage. The deck aims to control the game until it can assemble its combo pieces for a game-winning Scapeshift.

This deck focuses on fast and aggressive gameplay, utilizing low-cost creatures and disruptive spells to apply early pressure on the opponent. By combining strong aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer with disruptive cards like Thoughtseize and Grief, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while steadily chipping away at their life total. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Undying Evil and Monstrous Rage provide additional ways to protect and pump up creatures for maximum impact in combat.

This deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of countering spells, removal, and card advantage. It utilizes powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six, as well as versatile spells like Bring to Light and Prismatic Ending. The deck also includes powerful finishers like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines to quickly close out the game. By controlling the board and disrupting the opponent's strategy, this deck aims to dominate the game and secure victory.

The deck focuses on quick and aggressive creature plays, utilizing cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Grief to apply pressure on opponents. It also includes disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Terminate to control the board. The deck leverages graveyard manipulation with cards like Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Undying Evil. The mana base is optimized with fetch lands and shock lands to ensure consistent color availability. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with early aggression while disrupting their game plan.

This deck focuses on utilizing cascade spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays. By cascading into cards like Crashing Footfalls or Shardless Agent, the deck can flood the board with creatures and generate a lot of value. The deck also includes some control elements with cards like Force of Negation and Mystical Dispute to protect its threats. The inclusion of versatile cards like Dead / Gone and Fire / Ice allows the deck to adapt to different situations and maintain pressure on the opponent. Overall, the deck aims to be fast and unpredictable, keeping the opponent on their toes.

The key concept of this deck is to aggressively attack the opponent with powerful and disruptive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, Grief, and Dauthi Voidwalker while disrupting their hand with cards like Thoughtseize. The deck also utilizes cards like Terminate and Fatal Push to remove threats from the opponent's side of the board. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Feign Death to generate value and maintain pressure on the opponent. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly and efficiently to secure victory.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on early aggression and disruption, using cards like Thoughtseize and Grief to disrupt the opponent's game plan while deploying threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dauthi Voidwalker to apply pressure. The deck also utilizes removal spells like Terminate and Lightning Bolt to keep the opponent's board in check. The goal is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with efficient creatures and spells, while using cards like Undying Evil and Not Dead After All to maintain card advantage and resilience.

The deck aims to ramp quickly and efficiently using cards like Amulet of Vigor and Arboreal Grazer to get Primeval Titan out as soon as possible. With the ability to search for utility lands like Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and Sunhome, Fortress of the Legion, the deck can quickly assemble a powerful board state. The combination of lands like Selesnya Sanctuary and Simic Growth Chamber along with Amulet of Vigor allows for explosive plays and the potential to win the game in just a few turns. The inclusion of utility lands and cards like Dryad of the Ilysian Grove provide additional synergy and flexibility to the combo strategy.

This deck focuses on assembling a fast and aggressive board presence by combining efficient removal spells with powerful creatures that can disrupt the opponent's hand and control the game in the early turns. The use of cards like Thoughtseize and Grief helps to strip away key cards from the opponent's hand, while cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dauthi Voidwalker put pressure on the opponent's life total. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Undying Evil and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to further disrupt the opponent's game plan.
